Key Product Features

Warmer

Warms milk and water, anywhere

Heat a bottle of milk or water at the park, in the car or mid-flight. No kettle, hob or microwave needed.

Heats fast, with a long battery life

Quick heating means a hungry baby isn’t left waiting, and a long-lasting rechargeable battery keeps it ready for days out and long journeys.

Easy for everyone to use

Simple buttons and a clear temperature display make it effortless for anyone, from new parents to grandparents on babysitting duty.

Cooler

Iceless 360° cooling

Keeps breast milk cold for up to 24 hours without needing any ice, so it’s ready whenever you are.

650ml capacity, fits two 300ml bottles

Room for two full 300ml bottles, so you can carry a whole day’s feeds in one bottle.

Leak-proof lid

A secure leak-proof lid keeps your milk safely inside and your bag dry, so you can pack it with everything else without a second thought.

Everything you need for feeding on the move.

Warm milk or water with the portable warmer, then keep bottles fresh and cool with the matching portable cooler. Both are small enough for the nappy bag, car cup holder or carry-on.

How it works

1Cool it

Freeze the cooling cylinders for 12 hours, pop them in the cooler, and your milk stays cold for up to 24 hours.

2Carry it

Both are small enough for the nappy bag, car cup holder or carry-on.

3Warm it

When your baby is hungry, the warmer heats a bottle wherever you are.
